title: demo-fleet
description: Envelope of the simulated Driver fleet, schema/demo/fleet.demo-fleet.json. One file declares every simulated Driver; it is named *.demo-fleet.json so the per-entity scenario glob (*.demo.json) never matches it, and schema/validate-demo.py reads it in a separate pass. Each entry in `drivers` is a complete Driver info (validated against driver-info.schema.json) plus the health to show; driver-demo publishes it retained under renewvan/demo/<driver>/info and renewvan/demo/<driver>/health, only while Demo mode is on, and clears both when it is switched off. A Driver with no `info` publishes health only, to simulate a Driver that has not been updated. `health_timeline` overlays health at `t` seconds into the loop and resets to `health` at each loop start; exactly one Driver in the fleet carries one. driver-demo itself is a simulator, not a Driver, and has no entry. Versions and serials here are visibly fake and never read from the Pi. What JSON Schema cannot express (info.driver equals the entry key, the reserved key `demo`, every `publishes` type has an entity scenario, `t` ordered and < loop_s, exactly one flapping Driver) is checked by schema/validate-demo.py.

loop_s.description: Loop length in seconds. Shares the clock of the entity scenarios, so a Driver's health stays coherent with the entities it publishes.

driver.description: The Driver key: the <driver> segment of renewvan/demo/<driver>/info and /health. Same slug rule as driver-info.schema.json, and the reserved key `demo` is rejected (it would collide with renewvan/demo/health).

info.description: Complete Driver info, retained; validated against driver-info.schema.json by schema/validate-demo.py (a cross-file $ref would need a resolver in every consumer). Omit to simulate a Driver that publishes no info. info.driver must equal this entry's `driver`.

health.description: Health at loop start, published as a bare retained word. `offline` with an `info` present simulates a Driver that dropped and left its retained info.

t.description: Seconds from loop start; must be < loop_s and non-decreasing.

health_timeline.description: Optional. Health changes within the loop; health resets to `health` at each loop start. Exactly one Driver in the fleet has one.
